_meta.source: Niagara Falls Bridge Commission, 2024 Annual Review, Traffic Statistics (page 8): https://niagarafallsbridges.com/wp-content/uploads/2024-Annual-Review-low-res.pdf . Fiscal years November to October. All three NFBC bridges combined (Rainbow, Whirlpool Rapids, Lewiston-Queenston); west-bound (into Canada) only. Not split by bridge.
_meta.context: US Bureau of Transportation Statistics: personal-vehicle crossings from Canada at Buffalo-Niagara Falls fell 16.3% in calendar 2025 (https://www.bts.gov/newsroom/border-crossing-data-annual-release-2025). Rainbow Bridge cars fell 31.6% in April 2025 against April 2024 (https://www.wamc.org/2025-05-28/new-york-international-bridge-crossings-plunge-compared-to-last-year).

note: Chart labels read from the PDF text layer; the year order of the auto bars is inferred from the chart (pandemic low 0.20 in 2020-21). Trucks cross almost entirely at Lewiston-Queenston (Whirlpool is NEXUS-only cars, Rainbow bans trucks).
